headline: Senate passes education literacy bill and merchant marine athletes act; House adjourned after brief morning session

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed four bills on the floor including S. 3266 supporting USMMA athletic programs, S. 434 establishing the Commercial Space Activity Advisory Committee, S. 2398 reauthorizing the Kay Hagan Tick Act, and S. 1838 authorizing Down syndrome research. The chamber also agreed to several resolutions recognizing the 1960 Missouri Tigers football team, designating National Airborne Day and National Park Week, and commemorating the Fort Stewart shooting anniversary. Eighty-six bills and 13 resolutions were introduced.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly at 9 a.m. and adjourned at 9:03 a.m. No votes were taken. Twenty-six public bills and five resolutions were introduced. The Speaker appointed Representative Obernolte to act as Speaker pro tempore.
